# Palette Journal

## 2026-01-29 - Markdown Report Navigation
**Learning:** Large Markdown reports generated by CLI tools are difficult to navigate without a Table of Contents and "Back to Top" links. Standard Markdown headers with emojis can break auto-generated anchors.
**Action:** Implement explicit HTML anchors (`<a name='slug'></a>`) before headers and include a TOC + Back to Top links for any generated report longer than one screen.
